1: KHLESTAKOV. Oh! All right. I'll come presently.
2: GOVERNOR. What's that? Are you leaving?
4: GOVERNOR. Then when—that is—I thought you were pleased to hint at a wedding.
5: KHLESTAKOV. Oh—for one minute only—for one day—to my uncle, a rich old man. I'll be back tomorrow.
6: GOVERNOR. We would not venture, of course, to hold you back, and we hope for your safe return.
7: KHLESTAKOV. Of course, of course, I'll come back at once. Good-by, my dear—no, I simply can't express my feelings. Good-by, my heart. [Kisses Marya's hand.]
8: GOVERNOR. Don't you need something for the road? It seems to me you were pleased to be short of cash.
9: KHLESTAKOV, Oh, no, what for? [After a little thought.] However, if you like.
10: GOVERNOR. How much will you have?
11: KHLESTAKOV. You gave me two hundred then, that is, not two hundred, but four hundred—I don't want to take advantage of your mistake—you might let me have the same now so that it should be an even eight hundred.
12: GOVERNOR. Very well. [Takes the money out of his pocket-book.] The notes happen to be brand-new, too, as though on purpose.
13: KHLESTAKOV. Oh, yes. [Takes the bills and looks at them.] That's good. They say new money means good luck.
15: KHLESTAKOV. Good-by, Anton Antonovich. I am very much obliged to you for your hospitality. I admit with all my heart that I have never got such a good reception anywhere. Good-by, Anna Andreyevna. Good-by, my sweet-heart, Marya Antonovna.
16: All go out. Behind the Scenes.
